critical_code_review_comments: ai_copy_rotator.preview: because rewrite_copy() persists to copy_history unconditionally when it succeeds, previews DO get logged (source_id prefixed 'preview-'). The module docstring for the preview handler still says 'DO NOT persist' — comment is stale but behaviour matches the review-request spec (previews should persist under preview- prefix). Consider updating the docstring to match.
site_settings.SocialLinksBody: adsense_client regex allows 10-20 digits after 'ca-pub-'. Real Google publisher IDs are always 16 digits — narrowing the regex would catch typos earlier.
